titles.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya
titles.overview: A heartfelt romantic family drama about two best friends whose close bond slowly turns into love. But one lie creates misunderstandings and conflicts, putting their relationship and family bonds to the test. The story explores love, sacrifice, understanding and the importance of family.

titles.title: Pei Pidichirukku
titles.overview: An irresponsible businessman gets trapped in a dangerous deal with a rival company, triggering a series of mysterious and life-threatening events. As he seeks answers, he discovers that his deceased wife's spirit is behind his troubles, while his daughter's spirit has been protecting him. Caught between two spirits, he must fight to save his life and protect innocent children from an impending danger.

titles.title: Vāranāsi
titles.overview: Follows Rudhra's perilous adventures as ancient Varanasi stands on the brink of catastrophe from a looming asteroid in 2027 CE, unfolding across multiple timelines and distant continents.

titles.title: King
titles.overview: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

titles.title: Bokshi
titles.overview: Anahita, traumatised by the brutal disappearance of her mother, finds comfort in Shalini, her history teacher. On an unconventional school excursion to a mysterious prehistoric site, she confronts her terrifying destiny.

titles.title: Golmaal 5
titles.overview: Get ready for another rollercoaster of laughter with the iconic gang.

titles.title: Mysaa
titles.overview: Unafraid of war and unwilling to stop until she finds that one answer. She carries no doubts. Only the ache of an answer she's searched her whole life.

titles.title: Alias Rukmini
titles.overview: Krishna writes edgy and raunchy books under his wife Rukmini's name as a pseudonym, concealing his identity as the true author behind the provocative novels.

titles.title: Love & War
titles.overview: Two strong-willed Army officers find their lives intertwined with a woman, forming a complicated love triangle.

titles.title: Delivery Boy
titles.overview: A young food delivery rider, who dreams of becoming a police officer, is forced to steal money to save his critically injured mother. Months later, when he discovers that the same man has been falsely accused of murder, he risks everything to save the life he once unknowingly changed forever.

titles.title: Cosmic Samson
titles.overview: Aspiring filmmaker working as a pizza delivery guy whose ordinary life takes an extraordinary turn when mysterious forces unlock hidden superpowers within him, pulling him into a secret fantasy world and launching him on an epic, action-packed adventure beyond anything he has ever imagined.

titles.title: Sri Sri
titles.overview: He loved a girl with no past and gave her a future... Now destiny returns to take her back, steeped in a forgotten life, buried memories and claims he cannot disprove.
